notes.title: purgatory's flower Demo is on the June Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [h3][b]Demo of purgatory's flower is out ![/b] [/h3][h3]and[/h3][h3] we are participating in the [b]June Steam Next Fest[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/8974f9513ccb118a6b09994f3323b64bec334cd2.png"][/img][/p][h3]If you have time, please listen to the characters' stories for a moment.[/h3][h3]Purgatory flowers will be released in September.[/h3][p]This game deals with the miserable, tragic, and beautiful memories of two women, and the pain and healing that have occurred from them. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_Yws7WmKNG0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The amount of the demo is 1/5 of the total, and the playtime is about 30 minutes. [/p][p]several endings are waiting for you.[/p][p][/p][p]Demo game only supports English and Korean, but in the main game, English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, and Turkish are waiting. Also, translation volunteering is always welcome![/p][p][/p][p]Please enjoy the stories of prisoners struggling to escape from purgatory![/p]

notes.title: Turkish Translation Update!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the Turkish translation has been completed and updated, thanks to the generous help of our volunteer, Zeynep Nazli Kolkiran.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114503/2dcf4360788034f27cdb017fb59afc6a9da980dd.png[/img]

We deeply appreciate her contribution and hope you have a wonderful experience with the game. 

As always, we welcome volunteer translators! If you're interested, feel free to contact us at panhwa1004@naver.com. 

Thank you!

notes.title: 24/09/18 bug fix update!
notes.content:
I made a full correction of the game with minor errors.

[olist]
[*] Fixed an error that the camera didn't move to the left and right when saving/loading! It will move normally now.


[*] Steam Achievement 'Fake Rose' can now be achieved. Soon, I will write a Steam challenge for the challenge all clear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114503/e8e7da0368b3c4fb5828f15b20d7c2a3cacb9dc8.png[/img]

A native speaker helped me. Thank you!
[/olist]
